analysis.title: Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corp. (ZWS): Updating estimates post 3Q26
key_insights: ZWS reported 3Q26 adj. EBITDA of $140mn, +1% vs Visible Alpha consensus. Sales were in line with consensus and adj. EBITDA margin was about 25bps above consensus at 28.3%. Core organic growth was +7%.
Net leverage was 0.4x, helped by 3Q26 free cash flow of $110mn.

4Q26 guidance: adj. EBITDA of $120mn-$123mn (about +2% at the midpoint vs VA consensus of $119mn) and sales of $430mn-$437mn (vs VA consensus of $438mn). Management described the 4Q assumptions as conservative given the macro backdrop.
The 4Q sales guide implies about 4-5% core sales growth despite a modestly easier comp than 3Q. GS reads this as a modest deceleration in volume growth, assuming similar pricing.

For 2027, management expects moderating underlying growth but still positive core growth, supported by share gains, secular growth, MRO and normalized pricing of 1-2 pts, since tariff pricing has completely rolled off.
Management expects 40%+ incremental margins in FY27, vs 35%+ in FY26.
GS raised FY26/FY27/FY28 EBITDA estimates to $515mn/$545mn/$575mn (from $505mn/$535mn/$575mn). GS EPS estimates rise to $1.86/$2.00/$2.15 (from $1.81/$1.95/$2.10).
GS keeps a Neutral rating, citing better risk/reward elsewhere in its coverage, but says the post-results sell-off looked overdone and unwarranted.
The 12-month price target rises to $53 from $51 on a roll-forward of estimates, based on 16.0x (unchanged) Q5-Q8 EBITDA. The target implies about a 5% FY28 FCF yield and 21.8% upside from $43.50.

market_movers.rationale: GS raised the target to $53 from $51 on rolled-forward estimates and a 16.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA multiple. Neutral is maintained because GS sees better risk/reward elsewhere in coverage.
